profile.migration_strategy_justification: Create task bindings only after universal worktree lanes exist, then backfill exclusively from complete persisted epic_task_files budgets; ambiguous legacy task ownership is a hard preflight refusal.

invariants: Every binding references an existing item-owned path claim and an existing generated Epic task.
Task bindings carry no registering-session or work-claim authority and survive session handoff.
workflow_item_worktree_records applies first and every migrated task has valid worker-lane ownership.
Legacy bindings derive only from complete persisted epic_task_files budgets; empty, partial, cross-project, or unmapped claims refuse migration.
Repeat apply preserves existing rows and every nonterminal required-per-task item either remains pre-planning with no tasks or passes complete task coverage.
attestation.residual_risk_notes: The migration is additive and idempotent after readiness. It deliberately refuses the known live legacy Epics whose tasks have no persisted epic_task_files rather than inferring authority from prose, branches, or a bind-all fallback; those budgets must be repaired before apply.
